name: Prenzlau (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Prenzlau (a red eagle above a white swan).
history: Municipal flag of Prenzlau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Prenzlau arms — red eagle and swan
